text: Built a full-stack real-time messaging platform with server and channel architecture, supporting text, audio, and video communication via Socket.io and LiveKit
Developed a role-based permission system, invite link generation, and member moderation features using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Prisma ORM
Implemented Clerk authentication, UploadThing file uploads, and infinite-scroll message history using Tanstack Query with cursor-based pagination
